The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 孟子在那个商店也找了到工作：找到了

- 他的学习和他的旅行经验很重要，对他很多好处：delete the second他的，对他有很多好处

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: 找了到：找到了，The completion marker must come after the resultative complement; the correct order is verb + resultative + 了. [teacher rule: le_placement]

Run 3: 孟子在那个商店也找了到工作：孟子在那个商店也找到了工作，The perfective marker must come after the resultative complement: the resultative verb is 找到, so 了 follows 到. [teacher rule: le_placement]
